fields.Name: C1 -> C2.2
fields.Description: Gate G7.2 (owner PR 1, phase 7, dataset C1, criterion C2.2): on the MoreCheese people behind scenario C1, forced out-of-taxonomy job-title outputs are rejected and counted on the run, with 0 stored as feature values. Runs the installed job-title pipeline cloned onto a deterministic stub driver over the 52 golden-title fixture people plus 3 whose titles the stub answers outside the taxonomy (an unknown seniority, a non-existent job function ID, both); a supplementary check dry-runs an unconstrained clone and expects the foreign-key failure its real write would hit to be reported, with nothing written; no model calls.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The run ends Failed with RejectedInvalid 3 and the other 52 records written; 0 Feature Values, cache rows, seniority values or job-function rows are stored for the 3 rejected people; the dry run of an unconstrained clone reports 'Dry run: the real write would fail: …' and writes nothing.
